SUBJECT TO COMPLETION, DATED November 2, 2026 Preliminary Prospectus Supplement (To Prospectus dated November 2, 2026) $10,000,000,000 Common Stock We are offering $10,000,000,000 of shares of our common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“common stock”). Our common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “ORCL.” The last reported sale price of our common stock on October 30, 2026, as reported on the New York Stock Exchange, was $130.67 per share. Concurrently with this offering and pursuant to a separate prospectus supplement, we are making a public offering of $10,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of senior notes (collectively, the “Notes,” and the offering thereof, the “Concurrent Notes Offering”). The closing of this offering is not conditioned upon the closing of the Concurrent Notes Offering. The closing of the Concurrent Notes Offering is not conditioned upon the closing of this offering.
